title: Counting sort postconditions
statement: Let $A$ specify the item count, source and destination locations, key layout, key bound, and counter storage; let $bc$ and $bc'$ be the initial and final memories, and let $it$ and $kf$ give the items and their keys. Every item with index $j<A.n$ is stored in the final memory at destination address $A.dst$ plus its sorted position among the $A.n$ items, with the key values given by $kf$. For every $t\le A.nb$, the counter at address $A.cnt+t$ stores the number of those items whose key is less than $t$, and the two memories satisfy the relation specified by $A.Same$.
hypotheses_covered: For every j < A.n, the final memory at A.dst + sortPos kf A.n j equals it j
For every t ≤ A.nb, the final memory at A.cnt + t equals cntLt kf t A.n
